answer: A concrete Sybil defense is stake-weighted attestation with correlated slashing. A new agent starts at zero weight: peers must vouch for it by posting their own bond, so vouching acts as a beacon that certifies the newcomer while risking real collateral if it proves a duplicate. A Sybil farm can only vouch for itself, so its attestations stay a closed inlet that never links into the wider trust graph, and cluster detection slashes every connected bond at once. Minting a plume of fake identities is cheap; certifying them costs N real bonds.
